themes.title: Economic Protectionism and Domestic Resource Deregulation
themes.blurb: Right-wing political figures in both the United States and Norway are mounting aggressive campaigns to insulate domestic industries and consumers from high energy costs and environmental mandates. Trump's interventions to force coal plants to remain operational parallel Norwegian populist demands to roll back CO2 tax hikes and slash fuel duties.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Orders coal plants to remain open while advancing protectionist policies for domestic shrimpers and cattle ranchers.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Demands emergency parliamentary action to halt fuel tax increases and abolish CO2 tax hikes amid rising fuel prices.

themes.title: Right-Wing Parties Battle Electoral Rules and Funding Scrutiny
themes.blurb: Right-wing factions in the US and Norway face ongoing judicial, ethical, and legal challenges over election mechanics and party leadership. While US courts dismantle administration voting mandates and gerrymandered maps, Norwegian right-wing actors navigate internal party discipline and candidate scrutiny following local resignations.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Federal courts reject postal voting restrictions and redistricting maps while legal scrutiny surrounds promised election checks.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Local politicians seek comebacks after resigning over complaints while internal chapters pressure top leadership on policy stances.
